_note: Trigger words per LoRA, keyed by filename stem (no .safetensors).
_why: A LoRA only activates properly when the prompt contains the token it was captioned with, and every ANSI LoRA in the wild picked a different one. ansimon used to hardcode 'ansiart', which is right for ansi-art-xl and wrong for everything else — comparing LoRAs with the wrong trigger measures the base model, not the LoRA. `trigger` is prepended to the subject; "" means the LoRA needs none. `base` is the architecture it requires, and `--lora` refuses a mismatched --base.
_source: civitai /api/v1/model-versions/<id> trainedWords, verified at download time.
_adding: Drop the .safetensors in ComfyUI/models/loras and add an entry here. Without one, ansimon falls back to the --lora name's own stem being trigger-free and warns once.

ansi-art-xl.note: the default; ANSI Art Style XL

ascii-art-xl.note: ASCII ART [SD XL LoRA]; no trigger word

zxspectrum-xl.note: trigger is misspelled upstream ('syle') — kept verbatim, because that is the token it was trained on

dosegafx.note: pre-existing local LoRA; trigger inferred from the name
